"""Compare the outputs of HF and vLLM when using greedy sampling.

It tests chunked prefill. Chunked prefill can be enabled by
enable_chunked_prefill=True. If prefill size exceeds max_num_batched_tokens,
prefill requests are chunked.

Run `pytest tests/models/test_chunked_prefill.py`.
"""
from contextlib import nullcontext

import pytest

from ..models.utils import check_logprobs_close, check_outputs_equal

MODELS = [
    "facebook/opt-125m",
    "meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf",
]
E5M2_KV_MODELS = [
    "facebook/opt-125m",
    "meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf",
]
E4M3_KV_MODELS = [
    "meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf", "nm-testing/Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct-FP8-K-V",
    "nm-testing/TinyLlama-1.1B-compressed-tensors-kv-cache-scheme"
]
KV_CACHE_QUANTIZATION_PATHS = {
    "meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf":
    "./tests/fp8_kv/llama2-7b-fp8-kv/kv_cache_scales.json"
}


@pytest.mark.parametrize("model", MODELS)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", ["half"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_tokens", [32])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunked_prefill_token_size", [1, 4, 16])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("enforce_eager", [False, True])
# NOTE: Increasing this in this suite will fail CI because we currently cannot
# reset distributed env properly. Use a value > 1 just when you test.
@pytest.mark.parametrize("tensor_parallel_size", [1])
def test_models(
    hf_runner,
    vllm_runner,
    example_prompts,
    model: str,
    dtype: str,
    max_tokens: int,
    chunked_prefill_token_size: int,
    enforce_eager: bool,
    tensor_parallel_size: int,
) -> None:
    """
    Checks exact match decode between huggingface model and vllm runner with
    chunked prefill.
    """
    max_num_seqs = chunked_prefill_token_size
    max_num_batched_tokens = chunked_prefill_token_size

    with hf_runner(model, dtype=dtype) as hf_model:
        hf_outputs = hf_model.generate_greedy(example_prompts, max_tokens)

    with vllm_runner(
            model,
            dtype=dtype,
            max_num_batched_tokens=max_num_batched_tokens,
            enable_chunked_prefill=True,
            tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
            enforce_eager=enforce_eager,
            max_num_seqs=max_num_seqs,
    ) as vllm_model:
        vllm_outputs = vllm_model.generate_greedy(example_prompts, max_tokens)

    check_outputs_equal(
        outputs_0_lst=hf_outputs,
        outputs_1_lst=vllm_outputs,
        name_0="hf",
        name_1="vllm",
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_cache_dtype,model",
                         [("fp8_e5m2", m)
                          for m in E5M2_KV_MODELS] + [("fp8_e4m3", m)
                                                      for m in E4M3_KV_MODELS])
# Due to low-precision numerical divergence, we only test logprob of 4 tokens
@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_tokens", [4])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunked_prefill_token_size", [4, 16])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("enforce_eager", [False, True])
# NOTE: Increasing this in this suite will fail CI because we currently cannot
# reset distributed env properly. Use a value > 1 just when you test.
@pytest.mark.parametrize("tensor_parallel_size", [1])
# Due to low-precision numerical divergence, this test is too sensitive to
# the async postprocessor
@pytest.mark.parametrize("disable_async_output_proc", [True])
def test_models_with_fp8_kv_cache(
    vllm_runner,
    example_prompts,
    kv_cache_dtype: str,
    model: str,
    max_tokens: int,
    chunked_prefill_token_size: int,
    enforce_eager: bool,
    tensor_parallel_size: int,
    disable_async_output_proc: bool,
) -> None:
    """
    Only checks log probs match between chunked-prefill and
    non-chunked-prefill version of vLLM model runner.
    
    This test is used when there is discrepancy in kernels
    / numerics (e.g. when using lower-precision types like FP8).
    """
    NUM_LOG_PROBS = 8

    if model == "facebook/opt-125m":
        pytest.skip(
            "#7378: CUDA illegal memory access (undiagnosed) facebook/opt-125m"
        )
    if ((model, kv_cache_dtype, chunked_prefill_token_size) == (
            "nm-testing/Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct-FP8-K-V", "fp8_e4m3", 4)):
        pytest.skip("flakey test, see: #7874 #8051")

    max_num_seqs = chunked_prefill_token_size
    max_num_batched_tokens = chunked_prefill_token_size

    extra_kwargs = {}
    if model in KV_CACHE_QUANTIZATION_PATHS:
        extra_kwargs["quantization_param_path"] = KV_CACHE_QUANTIZATION_PATHS[
            model]

    with vllm_runner(
            model,
            tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
            enforce_eager=enforce_eager,
            max_num_seqs=max_num_seqs,
            kv_cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype,
            disable_async_output_proc=disable_async_output_proc,
            **extra_kwargs,
    ) as vllm_model:
        no_chunked_prefill_outputs = vllm_model.generate_greedy_logprobs(
            example_prompts, max_tokens, NUM_LOG_PROBS)

    with vllm_runner(
            model,
            max_num_batched_tokens=max_num_batched_tokens,
            enable_chunked_prefill=True,
            tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
            enforce_eager=enforce_eager,
            max_num_seqs=max_num_seqs,
            kv_cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype,
            disable_async_output_proc=disable_async_output_proc,
            **extra_kwargs,
    ) as vllm_model:
        chunked_prefill_outputs = vllm_model.generate_greedy_logprobs(
            example_prompts, max_tokens, NUM_LOG_PROBS)

    check_logprobs_close(
        outputs_0_lst=no_chunked_prefill_outputs,
        outputs_1_lst=chunked_prefill_outputs,
        name_0="no_chunked_prefill",
        name_1="chunked_prefill",
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_tokens", [16])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("enforce_eager", [False])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_size", [30, 32])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_v2_block_manager", [False, True])
# NOTE: Increasing this in this suite will fail CI because we currently cannot
# reset distributed env properly. Use a value > 1 just when you test.
@pytest.mark.parametrize("tensor_parallel_size", [1])
def test_with_prefix_caching(
    vllm_runner,
    max_tokens: int,
    enforce_eager: bool,
    chunk_size: int,
    use_v2_block_manager: bool,
    tensor_parallel_size: int,
) -> None:
    """
    Checks exact match decode with and without prefix caching
    with chunked prefill enabled.
    """
    model = "meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf"
    # The common prompt has 142 tokens with Llama-2 tokenizer.
    common_prompt = "You are a helpful AI assistant " * 20
    unique_prompts = [
        "Question",  # Warmup
        "Question",  # Fully cached
        "Another question",  # Partial cached
    ]
    full_prompts = [f"{common_prompt}\n{p}" for p in unique_prompts]

    max_num_batched_tokens = max_num_seqs = chunk_size
    outputs = {}  # type: ignore
    check_result = True
    for enable in (True, False):
        with vllm_runner(
                model,
                dtype="half",
                max_num_batched_tokens=max_num_batched_tokens,
                enable_chunked_prefill=True,
                enable_prefix_caching=enable,
                tensor_parallel_size=tensor_parallel_size,
                use_v2_block_manager=use_v2_block_manager,
                enforce_eager=enforce_eager,
                max_num_seqs=max_num_seqs,
        ) as vllm_model:
            # It should fail when prefix caching is enable and chunk
            # size is not a multiple of block size (16).
            should_fail = chunk_size % 16 != 0 and enable
            check_result &= not should_fail
            outputs[enable] = []
            # Send the request one-by-one to ensure the cache is populated.
            with pytest.raises(ValueError) if should_fail else nullcontext():
                for prompt in full_prompts:
                    outputs[enable] += vllm_model.generate_greedy([prompt],
                                                                  max_tokens)

    # Check results only if we did not expect a failure.
    if check_result:
        check_outputs_equal(
            outputs_0_lst=outputs[False],
            outputs_1_lst=outputs[True],
            name_0="w/o prefix caching",
            name_1="with prefix caching",
        )

    26→ARTIFICIAL_PREEMPTION_PROB = 0.5
    27→ARTIFICIAL_PREEMPTION_MAX_CNT = 500
    28→
    29→
    30→class PreemptionMode(enum.Enum):
    31→    """Preemption modes.
    32→
    33→    1. Swapping: Swap out the blocks of the preempted sequences to CPU memory
    34→    and swap them back in when the sequences are resumed.
    35→    2. Recomputation: Discard the blocks of the preempted sequences and
    36→    recompute them when the sequences are resumed, treating the sequences as
    37→    new prompts.
    38→    """
    39→    SWAP = enum.auto()
    40→    RECOMPUTE = enum.auto()
    41→
    42→
    43→@dataclass
    44→class SchedulingBudget:
    45→    """The available slots for scheduling.
    46→
    47→    TODO(sang): Right now, the budget is request_id-aware meaning it can ignore
    48→    budget update from the same request_id. It is because in normal scheduling
    49→    path, we update RUNNING num_seqs ahead of time, meaning it could be
    50→    updated more than once when scheduling RUNNING requests. Since this won't
    51→    happen if we only have chunked prefill scheduling, we can remove this
    52→    feature from the API when chunked prefill is enabled by default.
    53→    """
    54→    token_budget: int
    55→    max_num_seqs: int
    56→    _request_ids_num_batched_tokens: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    57→    _request_ids_num_curr_seqs: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    58→    _num_batched_tokens: int = 0
    59→    _num_curr_seqs: int = 0
    60→
    61→    def can_schedule(self, *, num_new_tokens: int, num_new_seqs: int):
    62→        assert num_new_tokens != 0
    63→        assert num_new_seqs != 0
    64→        return (self.num_batched_tokens + num_new_tokens <= self.token_budget
    65→                and self.num_curr_seqs + num_new_seqs <= self.max_num_seqs)
    66→
    67→    def remaining_token_budget(self):
    68→        return self.token_budget - self.num_batched_tokens
    69→
    70→    def add_num_batched_tokens(self, req_id: str, num_batched_tokens: int):
    71→        if req_id in self._request_ids_num_batched_tokens:
    72→            return
    73→
    74→        self._request_ids_num_batched_tokens.add(req_id)
    75→        self._num_batched_tokens += num_batched_tokens
    76→
    77→    def subtract_num_batched_tokens(self, req_id: str,
    78→                                    num_batched_tokens: int):
    79→        if req_id in self._request_ids_num_batched_tokens:
    80→            self._request_ids_num_batched_tokens.remove(req_id)
    81→            self._num_batched_tokens -= num_batched_tokens
    82→
    83→    def add_num_seqs(self, req_id: str, num_curr_seqs: int):
    84→        if req_id in self._request_ids_num_curr_seqs:
    85→            return
    86→
    87→        self._request_ids_num_curr_seqs.add(req_id)
    88→        self._num_curr_seqs += num_curr_seqs
    89→
    90→    def subtract_num_seqs(self, req_id: str, num_curr_seqs: int):
    91→        if req_id in self._request_ids_num_curr_seqs:
    92→            self._request_ids_num_curr_seqs.remove(req_id)
    93→            self._num_curr_seqs -= num_curr_seqs
    94→
    95→    @property
    96→    def num_batched_tokens(self):
    97→        return self._num_batched_tokens
    98→
    99→    @property
   100→    def num_curr_seqs(self):
   101→        return self._num_curr_seqs

   105→class ScheduledSequenceGroup:
   106→    # A sequence group that's scheduled.
   107→    seq_group: SequenceGroup
   108→    # The total chunk size (number of tokens) to process for next iteration.
   109→    # 1 for decoding. Same as prompt tokens for prefill, but if prefill is
   110→    # chunked, it can be smaller than that.

   114→@dataclass
   115→class SchedulerOutputs:
   116→    """The scheduling decision made from a scheduler."""
   117→    # Scheduled sequence groups.
   118→    scheduled_seq_groups: Iterable[ScheduledSequenceGroup]
   119→    # Number of prefill groups scheduled.
   120→    num_prefill_groups: int
   121→    # Total number of batched tokens.
   122→    num_batched_tokens: int
   123→    # Blocks to swap in. List of CPU -> GPU block number.
   124→    blocks_to_swap_in: List[Tuple[int, int]]
   125→    # Blocks to swap out. List of GPU -> CPU block number.
   126→    blocks_to_swap_out: List[Tuple[int, int]]
   127→    # Blocks to copy. Source to dest block.
   128→    blocks_to_copy: List[Tuple[int, int]]
   129→    # Sequence groups that are going to be ignored.
   130→    ignored_seq_groups: List[SequenceGroup]
   131→    # The number of slots for lookahead decoding.
   132→    num_lookahead_slots: int
   133→    # The number of requests in the running queue
   134→    running_queue_size: int
   135→    preempted: int
   136→
   137→    def __post_init__(self):
   138→        # Swap in and swap out should never happen at the same time.
   139→        assert not (self.blocks_to_swap_in and self.blocks_to_swap_out)
   140→
   141→        self.num_loras: int = len(self.lora_requests)
   142→        if self.num_loras > 0:
   143→            self._sort_by_lora_ids()
   144→
   145→        self.num_prompt_adapters: int = len(self.prompt_adapter_requests)
   146→
   147→    def is_empty(self) -> bool:
   148→        # NOTE: We do not consider the ignored sequence groups.
   149→        return (not self.scheduled_seq_groups and not self.blocks_to_swap_in
   150→                and not self.blocks_to_swap_out and not self.blocks_to_copy)
   151→
   152→    def _sort_by_lora_ids(self):
   153→        self.scheduled_seq_groups = sorted(
   154→            self.scheduled_seq_groups,
   155→            key=lambda g: (g.seq_group.lora_int_id, g.seq_group.request_id))
   156→
   157→    @property
   158→    def lora_requests(self) -> Set[LoRARequest]:
   159→        return {
   160→            g.seq_group.lora_request
   161→            for g in self.scheduled_seq_groups
   162→            if g.seq_group.lora_request is not None
   163→        }
   164→
   165→    @property
   166→    def prompt_adapter_requests(self) -> Set[PromptAdapterRequest]:
   167→        return {
   168→            g.seq_group.prompt_adapter_request
   169→            for g in self.scheduled_seq_groups
   170→            if g.seq_group.prompt_adapter_request is not None
   171→        }

   297→class Scheduler:
   298→
   299→    def __init__(
   300→        self,
   301→        scheduler_config: SchedulerConfig,
   302→        cache_config: CacheConfig,
   303→        lora_config: Optional[LoRAConfig],
   304→        pipeline_parallel_size: int = 1,
   305→        output_proc_callback: Optional[Callable] = None,
   306→    ) -> None:
   307→        self.scheduler_config = scheduler_config
   308→        self.cache_config = cache_config
   309→        # Note for LoRA scheduling: the current policy is extremely
   310→        # simple and NOT fair. It can lead to starvation of some
   311→        # LoRAs. This should be improved in the future.
   312→        self.lora_config = lora_config
   313→
   314→        version = "v1"
   315→        if self.scheduler_config.use_v2_block_manager:
   316→            version = "v2"
   317→        if self.scheduler_config.embedding_mode:
   318→            version = "embedding"
   319→
   320→        BlockSpaceManagerImpl = BlockSpaceManager.get_block_space_manager_class(
   321→            version)
   322→
   323→        num_gpu_blocks = cache_config.num_gpu_blocks
   324→        if num_gpu_blocks:
   325→            num_gpu_blocks //= pipeline_parallel_size
   326→
   327→        num_cpu_blocks = cache_config.num_cpu_blocks
   328→        if num_cpu_blocks:
   329→            num_cpu_blocks //= pipeline_parallel_size
   330→
   331→        # Create the block space manager.
   332→        self.block_manager = BlockSpaceManagerImpl(
   333→            block_size=self.cache_config.block_size,
   334→            num_gpu_blocks=num_gpu_blocks,
   335→            num_cpu_blocks=num_cpu_blocks,
   336→            sliding_window=self.cache_config.sliding_window,
   337→            enable_caching=self.cache_config.enable_prefix_caching)
   338→
   339→        # Sequence groups in the WAITING state.
   340→        # Contain new prefill or preempted requests.
   341→        self.waiting: Deque[SequenceGroup] = deque()
   342→        # Sequence groups in the RUNNING state.
   343→        # Contain decode requests.
   344→        self.running: Deque[SequenceGroup] = deque()
   345→        # Sequence groups in the SWAPPED state.
   346→        # Contain decode requests that are swapped out.
   347→        self.swapped: Deque[SequenceGroup] = deque()
   348→        # Sequence groups finished requests ids since last step iteration.
   349→        # It lets the model know that any state associated with these requests
   350→        # can and must be released after the current step.
   351→        # This is used to evict the finished requests from the Mamba cache.
   352→        self._finished_requests_ids: List[str] = list()
   353→        # Time at previous scheduling step
   354→        self.prev_time = 0.0
   355→        # Did we schedule a prompt at previous step?
   356→        self.prev_prompt = False
   357→        # Latency of the last prompt step
   358→        self.last_prompt_latency = 0.0
   359→        # preemption mode, RECOMPUTE or SWAP
   360→        self.user_specified_preemption_mode = scheduler_config.preemption_mode
   361→
   362→        # The following field is test-only. It is used to inject artificial
   363→        # preemption.
   364→        self.enable_artificial_preemption = ENABLE_ARTIFICIAL_PREEMPT
   365→        self.artificial_preempt_cnt = (ARTIFICIAL_PREEMPTION_MAX_CNT
   366→                                       if self.enable_artificial_preemption
   367→                                       else 0)
   368→        self.num_cumulative_preemption: int = 0
   369→
   370→        # Used to cache python objects
   371→        self._seq_group_metadata_cache: List[PyObjectCache] = []
   372→        self._scheduler_running_outputs_cache: List[PyObjectCache] = []
   373→        self._scheduled_seq_group_cache: List[PyObjectCache] = []
   374→
   375→        # For async output processing, we need to swap cache buffers between
   376→        # iterations. I.e. since the output processing is lagged one step,
   377→        # we cannot reuse the cached objects immediately when the schedule()
   378→        # is called again, but only when schedule() is called the second time.
   379→        self.output_proc_callback = output_proc_callback
   380→        self.use_async_output_proc = self.output_proc_callback is not None
   381→        self.num_cache_iters = 2 if self.use_async_output_proc else 1
   382→
   383→        self.cache_id = 0
   384→        for i in range(self.num_cache_iters):
   385→            self._seq_group_metadata_cache.append(
   386→                PyObjectCache(seq_group_metadata_builder))
   387→            self._scheduler_running_outputs_cache.append(
   388→                PyObjectCache(scheduler_running_outputs_builder))
   389→            self._scheduled_seq_group_cache.append(
   390→                PyObjectCache(scheduled_seq_group_builder))
   391→
   392→        # For async postprocessor, the extra decode run cannot be done
   393→        # when the request reaches max_model_len. In this case, the request
   394→        # will be stopped during schedule() call and added to this stop list
   395→        # for processing and deallocation by the free_finished_seq_groups()
   396→        self._async_stopped: List[SequenceGroup] = []
   397→
   398→    @property
   399→    def next_cache_id(self):
   400→        return (self.cache_id + 1) % self.num_cache_iters
   401→
   402→    @property
   403→    def lora_enabled(self) -> bool:
   404→        return bool(self.lora_config)
   405→
   406→    @property
   407→    def num_decoding_tokens_per_seq(self) -> int:
   408→        """The number of new tokens."""
   409→        return 1
   410→
   411→    def add_seq_group(self, seq_group: SequenceGroup) -> None:
   412→        # Add sequence groups to the waiting queue.
   413→        self.waiting.append(seq_group)
   414→
   415→    def _add_seq_group_to_running(self, seq_group: SequenceGroup) -> None:
   416→        # Add sequence groups to the running queue.
   417→        # Only for testing purposes.
   418→        self.running.append(seq_group)
   419→
   420→    def _add_seq_group_to_swapped(self, seq_group: SequenceGroup) -> None:
   421→        # Add sequence groups to the swapped queue.
   422→        # Only for testing purposes.
   423→        self.swapped.append(seq_group)
   424→
   425→    def abort_seq_group(self, request_id: Union[str, Iterable[str]]) -> None:
   426→        """Aborts a sequence group with the given ID.
   427→
   428→        Check if the sequence group with the given ID
   429→            is present in any of the state queue.
   430→        If present, remove the sequence group from the state queue.
   431→            Also, if any of the sequences in the sequence group is not finished,
   432→                free the sequence with status `FINISHED_ABORTED`.
   433→        Otherwise, do nothing.
   434→
   435→        Args:
   436→            request_id: The ID(s) of the sequence group to abort.
   437→        """
   438→        if isinstance(request_id, str):
   439→            request_id = (request_id, )
   440→        request_ids = set(request_id)
   441→        for state_queue in [self.waiting, self.running, self.swapped]:
   442→            aborted_groups: List[SequenceGroup] = []
   443→            for seq_group in state_queue:
   444→                if not request_ids:
   445→                    # Using 'break' here may add two extra iterations,
   446→                    # but is acceptable to reduce complexity.
   447→                    break
   448→                if seq_group.request_id in request_ids:
   449→                    # Appending aborted group into pending list.
   450→                    aborted_groups.append(seq_group)
   451→                    request_ids.remove(seq_group.request_id)
   452→            for aborted_group in aborted_groups:
   453→                # Remove the sequence group from the state queue.
   454→                state_queue.remove(aborted_group)
   455→                # Remove the aborted request from the Mamba cache.
   456→                self._finished_requests_ids.append(aborted_group.request_id)
   457→                for seq in aborted_group.get_seqs():
   458→                    if seq.is_finished():
   459→                        continue
   460→                    seq.status = SequenceStatus.FINISHED_ABORTED
   461→                    self.free_seq(seq)
   462→
   463→                self._free_seq_group_cross_attn_blocks(aborted_group)
   464→
   465→    def _free_seq_group_cross_attn_blocks(
   466→        self,
   467→        seq_group: SequenceGroup,
   468→    ) -> None:
   469→        """
   470→        Free a sequence group from a cross-attention block table.
   471→        Has no effect on decoder-only models.
   472→        """
   473→        if seq_group.is_encoder_decoder():
   474→            self.block_manager.free_cross(seq_group)
   475→
   476→    def has_unfinished_seqs(self) -> bool:
   477→        return len(self.waiting) != 0 or len(self.running) != 0 or len(
   478→            self.swapped) != 0
   479→
   480→    def get_prefix_cache_hit_rate(self, device: Device) -> float:
   481→        return self.block_manager.get_prefix_cache_hit_rate(device)
   482→
   483→    def get_num_unfinished_seq_groups(self) -> int:
   484→        return len(self.waiting) + len(self.running) + len(self.swapped)
   485→
   486→    def get_and_reset_finished_requests_ids(self) -> List[str]:
   487→        """Flushes the list of request ids of previously finished seq_groups."""
   488→        finished_requests_ids = self._finished_requests_ids
   489→        self._finished_requests_ids = list()
   490→        return finished_requests_ids
   491→
   492→    def _schedule_running(
   493→        self,
   494→        budget: SchedulingBudget,
   495→        curr_loras: Optional[Set[int]],
   496→        enable_chunking: bool = False,
   497→    ) -> SchedulerRunningOutputs:
   498→        """Schedule sequence groups that are running.
   499→
   500→        Running queue should include decode and chunked prefill requests.
   501→
   502→        Args:
   503→            budget: The scheduling budget. The argument is in-place updated
   504→                when any decodes are preempted.
   505→            curr_loras: Currently batched lora request ids. The argument is
   506→                in-place updated when any decodes are preempted.
   507→            enable_chunking: If True, seq group can be chunked and only a
   508→                chunked number of tokens are scheduled  if
   509→                `budget.num_batched_tokens` has not enough capacity to schedule
   510→                all tokens.
   511→    
   512→        Returns:
   513→            SchedulerRunningOutputs.
   514→        """
   515→        ret: SchedulerRunningOutputs = \
   516→            self._scheduler_running_outputs_cache[self.cache_id].get_object()
   517→        ret.blocks_to_swap_out.clear()
   518→        ret.blocks_to_copy.clear()
   519→        ret.decode_seq_groups.clear()
   520→        ret.prefill_seq_groups.clear()
   521→        ret.preempted.clear()
   522→        ret.swapped_out.clear()
   523→
   524→        ret.num_lookahead_slots = self._get_num_lookahead_slots(
   525→            is_prefill=False)
   526→
   527→        ret.decode_seq_groups_list.clear()
   528→        ret.prefill_seq_groups_list.clear()
   529→
   530→        # Blocks that need to be swapped or copied before model execution.
   531→        blocks_to_swap_out: List[Tuple[int, int]] = ret.blocks_to_swap_out
   532→        blocks_to_copy: List[Tuple[int, int]] = ret.blocks_to_copy
   533→
   534→        decode_seq_groups: List[ScheduledSequenceGroup] = ret.decode_seq_groups
   535→        prefill_seq_groups: List[
   536→            ScheduledSequenceGroup] = ret.prefill_seq_groups
   537→        preempted: List[SequenceGroup] = ret.preempted
   538→        swapped_out: List[SequenceGroup] = ret.swapped_out
   539→
   540→        # NOTE(woosuk): Preemption happens only when there is no available slot
   541→        # to keep all the sequence groups in the RUNNING state.
   542→
   543→        # Store original running requests for the case of async + preemption
   544→        if self.use_async_output_proc:
   545→            orig_running = self.running.copy()
   546→
   547→        running_queue = self.running
   548→        assert len(self._async_stopped) == 0
   549→        while running_queue:
   550→            seq_group = running_queue[0]
   551→            num_running_tokens = self._get_num_new_tokens(
   552→                seq_group, SequenceStatus.RUNNING, enable_chunking, budget)
   553→
   554→            if num_running_tokens == 0:
   555→                break
   556→
   557→            running_queue.popleft()
   558→
   559→            # With async postprocessor, an extra decode run is done
   560→            # to process the final tokens. The check below avoids this extra
   561→            # decode run when the model max len is reached, in order to avoid
   562→            # a memory overflow.
   563→            if self.use_async_output_proc and seq_group.seqs[0].get_len(
   564→            ) > self.scheduler_config.max_model_len:
   565→                self._async_stopped.append(seq_group)
   566→                continue
   567→
   568→            # With async postprocessor, when preemption kicks in, we need
   569→            # first to drain the async postprocessor, so that all async
   570→            # block_table freeing is applied before the preemption freeing
   571→            # is applied.
   572→            if self.use_async_output_proc and not self._can_append_slots(
   573→                    seq_group):
   574→                tmp = self.running
   575→                self.running = orig_running
   576→                assert self.output_proc_callback is not None
   577→                self.output_proc_callback()
   578→                self.running = tmp
   579→
   580→            while not self._can_append_slots(seq_group):
   581→                budget.subtract_num_batched_tokens(seq_group.request_id,
   582→                                                   num_running_tokens)
   583→                num_running_seqs = seq_group.get_max_num_running_seqs()
   584→                budget.subtract_num_seqs(seq_group.request_id,
   585→                                         num_running_seqs)
   586→
   587→                if (curr_loras is not None and seq_group.lora_int_id > 0
   588→                        and seq_group.lora_int_id in curr_loras):
   589→                    curr_loras.remove(seq_group.lora_int_id)
   590→
   591→                if running_queue:
   592→                    # Preempt the lowest-priority sequence groups.
   593→                    victim_seq_group = running_queue.pop()
   594→                    preempted_mode = self._preempt(victim_seq_group,
   595→                                                   blocks_to_swap_out)
   596→                    if preempted_mode == PreemptionMode.RECOMPUTE:
   597→                        preempted.append(victim_seq_group)
   598→                    else:
   599→                        swapped_out.append(victim_seq_group)
   600→                else:
   601→                    # No other sequence groups can be preempted.
   602→                    # Preempt the current sequence group.
   603→                    preempted_mode = self._preempt(seq_group,
   604→                                                   blocks_to_swap_out)
   605→                    if preempted_mode == PreemptionMode.RECOMPUTE:
   606→                        preempted.append(seq_group)
   607→                    else:
   608→                        swapped_out.append(seq_group)
   609→                    break
   610→            else:
   611→                self._append_slots(seq_group, blocks_to_copy)
   612→                is_prefill = seq_group.is_prefill()
   613→
   614→                scheduled_seq_group: ScheduledSequenceGroup = \
   615→                    self._scheduled_seq_group_cache[self.cache_id].get_object()
   616→                scheduled_seq_group.seq_group = seq_group
   617→                if is_prefill:
   618→                    scheduled_seq_group.token_chunk_size = num_running_tokens
   619→                    prefill_seq_groups.append(scheduled_seq_group)
   620→                    ret.prefill_seq_groups_list.append(seq_group)
   621→                else:
   622→                    scheduled_seq_group.token_chunk_size = 1
   623→                    decode_seq_groups.append(scheduled_seq_group)
   624→                    ret.decode_seq_groups_list.append(seq_group)
   625→
   626→                budget.add_num_batched_tokens(seq_group.request_id,
   627→                                              num_running_tokens)
   628→                # OPTIMIZATION:  Note that get_max_num_running_seqs is
   629→                # expensive. For the default scheduling chase where
   630→                # enable_chunking is False, num_seqs are updated before running
   631→                # this method, so we don't have to update it again here.
   632→                if enable_chunking:
   633→                    num_running_seqs = seq_group.get_max_num_running_seqs()
   634→                    budget.add_num_seqs(seq_group.request_id, num_running_seqs)
   635→                if curr_loras is not None and seq_group.lora_int_id > 0:
   636→                    curr_loras.add(seq_group.lora_int_id)
   637→
   638→        self._scheduler_running_outputs_cache[self.next_cache_id].reset()
   639→        self._scheduled_seq_group_cache[self.next_cache_id].reset()
   640→
   641→        return ret

   643→    def _schedule_swapped(
   644→        self,
   645→        budget: SchedulingBudget,
   646→        curr_loras: Optional[Set[int]],
   647→        enable_chunking: bool = False,
   648→    ) -> SchedulerSwappedInOutputs:
   649→        """Schedule sequence groups that are swapped out.
   650→
   651→        It schedules swapped requests as long as it fits `budget` and
   652→        curr_loras <= max_lora from the scheduling config. The input arguments
   653→        `budget` and `curr_loras` are updated based on scheduled seq_groups.
   654→
   655→        Args:
   656→            budget: The scheduling budget. The argument is in-place updated
   657→                when any requests are swapped in.
   658→            curr_loras: Currently batched lora request ids. The argument is
   659→                in-place updated when any requests are swapped in.
   660→            enable_chunking: If True, seq group can be chunked and only a
   661→                chunked number of tokens are scheduled  if
   662→                `budget.num_batched_tokens` has not enough capacity to schedule
   663→                all tokens.
   664→
   665→        Returns:
   666→            SchedulerSwappedInOutputs.
   667→        """
   668→        # Blocks that need to be swapped or copied before model execution.
   669→        blocks_to_swap_in: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
   670→        blocks_to_copy: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
   671→        decode_seq_groups: List[ScheduledSequenceGroup] = []
   672→        prefill_seq_groups: List[ScheduledSequenceGroup] = []
   673→        infeasible_seq_groups: List[SequenceGroup] = []
   674→
   675→        swapped_queue = self.swapped
   676→
   677→        leftover_swapped: Deque[SequenceGroup] = deque()
   678→        while swapped_queue:
   679→            seq_group = swapped_queue[0]
   680→
   681→            # If the sequence group cannot be swapped in, stop.
   682→            is_prefill = seq_group.is_prefill()
   683→            alloc_status = self.block_manager.can_swap_in(
   684→                seq_group, self._get_num_lookahead_slots(is_prefill))
   685→            if alloc_status == AllocStatus.LATER:
   686→                break
   687→            elif alloc_status == AllocStatus.NEVER:
   688→                logger.warning(
   689→                    "Failing the request %s because there's not enough kv "
   690→                    "cache blocks to run the entire sequence.",
   691→                    seq_group.request_id)
   692→                for seq in seq_group.get_seqs():
   693→                    seq.status = SequenceStatus.FINISHED_IGNORED
   694→                infeasible_seq_groups.append(seq_group)
   695→                swapped_queue.popleft()
   696→                continue
   697→
   698→            lora_int_id = 0
   699→            if self.lora_enabled:
   700→                lora_int_id = seq_group.lora_int_id
   701→                assert curr_loras is not None
   702→                assert self.lora_config is not None
   703→                if (lora_int_id > 0 and (lora_int_id not in curr_loras)
   704→                        and len(curr_loras) >= self.lora_config.max_loras):
   705→                    # We don't have a space for another LoRA, so
   706→                    # we ignore this request for now.
   707→                    leftover_swapped.appendleft(seq_group)
   708→                    swapped_queue.popleft()
   709→                    continue
   710→
   711→            # The total number of sequences in the RUNNING state should not
   712→            # exceed the maximum number of sequences.
   713→            num_new_seqs = seq_group.get_max_num_running_seqs()
   714→            num_new_tokens = self._get_num_new_tokens(seq_group,
   715→                                                      SequenceStatus.SWAPPED,
   716→                                                      enable_chunking, budget)
   717→
   718→            if (num_new_tokens == 0
   719→                    or not budget.can_schedule(num_new_tokens=num_new_tokens,
   720→                                               num_new_seqs=num_new_seqs)):
   721→                break
   722→
   723→            if lora_int_id > 0 and curr_loras is not None:
   724→                curr_loras.add(lora_int_id)
   725→            swapped_queue.popleft()
   726→            self._swap_in(seq_group, blocks_to_swap_in)
   727→            self._append_slots(seq_group, blocks_to_copy)
   728→            is_prefill = seq_group.is_prefill()
   729→            if is_prefill:
   730→                prefill_seq_groups.append(
   731→                    ScheduledSequenceGroup(seq_group,
   732→                                           token_chunk_size=num_new_tokens))
   733→            else:
   734→                decode_seq_groups.append(
   735→                    ScheduledSequenceGroup(seq_group, token_chunk_size=1))
   736→            budget.add_num_batched_tokens(seq_group.request_id, num_new_tokens)
   737→            budget.add_num_seqs(seq_group.request_id, num_new_seqs)
   738→
   739→        swapped_queue.extendleft(leftover_swapped)
   740→
   741→        return SchedulerSwappedInOutputs(
   742→            decode_seq_groups=decode_seq_groups,
   743→            prefill_seq_groups=prefill_seq_groups,
   744→            blocks_to_swap_in=blocks_to_swap_in,
   745→            blocks_to_copy=blocks_to_copy,
   746→            num_lookahead_slots=self._get_num_lookahead_slots(
   747→                is_prefill=False),
   748→            infeasible_seq_groups=infeasible_seq_groups,
   749→        )

   751→    def _get_prompt_limit(self, seq_group: SequenceGroup) -> int:
   752→        if self.scheduler_config.chunked_prefill_enabled:
   753→            prompt_limit = self.scheduler_config.max_model_len
   754→        else:
   755→            prompt_limit = min(self.scheduler_config.max_model_len,
   756→                               self.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens)
   757→
   758→        # Model is fine tuned with long context. Return the fine tuned max_len.
   759→        if (seq_group.lora_request
   760→                and seq_group.lora_request.long_lora_max_len):
   761→            assert prompt_limit <= seq_group.lora_request.long_lora_max_len
   762→            return seq_group.lora_request.long_lora_max_len
   763→        else:
   764→            return prompt_limit

   766→    def _schedule_prefills(
   767→        self,
   768→        budget: SchedulingBudget,
   769→        curr_loras: Optional[Set[int]],
   770→        enable_chunking: bool = False,
   771→    ) -> SchedulerPrefillOutputs:
   772→        """Schedule sequence groups that are in prefill stage.
   773→
   774→        Note that the current scheduler treats PREEMPTED_FOR_RECOMPUTE
   775→        as a new prefill (that starts from beginning -> most recently generated
   776→        tokens).
   777→
   778→        It schedules waiting requests as long as it fits `budget` and
   779→        curr_loras <= max_lora from the scheduling config. The input arguments
   780→        `budget` and `curr_loras` are updated based on scheduled seq_groups.
   781→
   782→        Args:
   783→            budget: The scheduling budget. The argument is in-place updated
   784→                when any requests are scheduled.
   785→            curr_loras: Currently batched lora request ids. The argument is
   786→                in-place updated when any requests are scheduled.
   787→            enable_chunking: If True, seq group can be chunked and only a
   788→                chunked number of tokens are scheduled  if
   789→                `budget.num_batched_tokens` has not enough capacity to schedule
   790→                all tokens.
   791→
   792→        Returns:
   793→            SchedulerPrefillOutputs.
   794→        """
   795→        ignored_seq_groups: List[SequenceGroup] = []
   796→        seq_groups: List[ScheduledSequenceGroup] = []
   797→
   798→        waiting_queue = self.waiting
   799→
   800→        leftover_waiting_sequences: Deque[SequenceGroup] = deque()
   801→        while self._passed_delay(time.time()) and waiting_queue:
   802→            seq_group = waiting_queue[0]
   803→
   804→            waiting_seqs = seq_group.get_seqs(status=SequenceStatus.WAITING)
   805→            assert len(waiting_seqs) == 1, (
   806→                "Waiting sequence group should have only one prompt "
   807→                "sequence.")
   808→            num_new_tokens = self._get_num_new_tokens(seq_group,
   809→                                                      SequenceStatus.WAITING,
   810→                                                      enable_chunking, budget)
   811→            if not enable_chunking:
   812→                num_prompt_tokens = waiting_seqs[0].get_len()
   813→                assert num_new_tokens == num_prompt_tokens
   814→
   815→            prompt_limit = self._get_prompt_limit(seq_group)
   816→            if num_new_tokens > prompt_limit:
   817→                logger.warning(
   818→                    "Input prompt (%d tokens) is too long"
   819→                    " and exceeds limit of %d", num_new_tokens, prompt_limit)
   820→                for seq in waiting_seqs:
   821→                    seq.status = SequenceStatus.FINISHED_IGNORED
   822→                ignored_seq_groups.append(seq_group)
   823→                waiting_queue.popleft()
   824→                continue
   825→
   826→            # If the sequence group cannot be allocated, stop.
   827→            can_allocate = self.block_manager.can_allocate(seq_group)
   828→            if can_allocate == AllocStatus.LATER:
   829→                break
   830→            elif can_allocate == AllocStatus.NEVER:
   831→                logger.warning(
   832→                    "Input prompt (%d tokens) is too long"
   833→                    " and exceeds the capacity of block_manager",
   834→                    num_new_tokens)
   835→                for seq in waiting_seqs:
   836→                    seq.status = SequenceStatus.FINISHED_IGNORED
   837→                ignored_seq_groups.append(seq_group)
   838→                waiting_queue.popleft()
   839→                continue
   840→
   841→            lora_int_id = 0
   842→            if self.lora_enabled:
   843→                lora_int_id = seq_group.lora_int_id
   844→                assert curr_loras is not None
   845→                assert self.lora_config is not None
   846→                if (self.lora_enabled and lora_int_id > 0
   847→                        and lora_int_id not in curr_loras
   848→                        and len(curr_loras) >= self.lora_config.max_loras):
   849→                    # We don't have a space for another LoRA, so
   850→                    # we ignore this request for now.
   851→                    leftover_waiting_sequences.appendleft(seq_group)
   852→                    waiting_queue.popleft()
   853→                    continue
   854→
   855→            num_new_seqs = seq_group.get_max_num_running_seqs()
   856→            if (num_new_tokens == 0
   857→                    or not budget.can_schedule(num_new_tokens=num_new_tokens,
   858→                                               num_new_seqs=num_new_seqs)):
   859→                break
   860→
   861→            # Can schedule this request.
   862→            if curr_loras is not None and lora_int_id > 0:
   863→                curr_loras.add(lora_int_id)
   864→            waiting_queue.popleft()
   865→            self._allocate_and_set_running(seq_group)
   866→            seq_group.init_multi_step(
   867→                num_scheduler_steps=self._get_num_lookahead_slots(
   868→                    is_prefill=True) + 1)
   869→            seq_groups.append(
   870→                ScheduledSequenceGroup(seq_group=seq_group,
   871→                                       token_chunk_size=num_new_tokens))
   872→            budget.add_num_batched_tokens(seq_group.request_id, num_new_tokens)
   873→            budget.add_num_seqs(seq_group.request_id, num_new_seqs)
   874→
   875→        # Queue requests that couldn't be scheduled.
   876→        waiting_queue.extendleft(leftover_waiting_sequences)
   877→        if len(seq_groups) > 0:
   878→            self.prev_prompt = True
   879→
   880→        return SchedulerPrefillOutputs(
   881→            seq_groups=seq_groups,
   882→            ignored_seq_groups=ignored_seq_groups,
   883→            num_lookahead_slots=self._get_num_lookahead_slots(is_prefill=True))

   885→    def _schedule_default(self) -> SchedulerOutputs:
   886→        """Schedule queued requests.
   887→        
   888→        The current policy is designed to optimize the throughput. First,
   889→        it batches as many prefill requests as possible. And it schedules
   890→        decodes. If there's a pressure on GPU memory, decode requests can
   891→        be swapped or preempted.
   892→        """
   893→        # Include running requests to the budget.
   894→        budget = SchedulingBudget(
   895→            token_budget=self.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
   896→            max_num_seqs=self.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs,
   897→        )
   898→        # Make sure we include num running seqs before scheduling prefill,
   899→        # so that we don't schedule beyond max_num_seqs for prefill.
   900→        for seq_group in self.running:
   901→            budget.add_num_seqs(seq_group.request_id,
   902→                                seq_group.get_max_num_running_seqs())
   903→        curr_loras = set(
   904→            seq_group.lora_int_id for seq_group in self.running
   905→            if seq_group.lora_int_id > 0) if self.lora_enabled else None
   906→
   907→        prefills = SchedulerPrefillOutputs.create_empty()
   908→        running_scheduled = SchedulerRunningOutputs.create_empty()
   909→        swapped_in = SchedulerSwappedInOutputs.create_empty()
   910→
   911→        # If any requests are swapped, prioritized swapped requests.
   912→        if not self.swapped:
   913→            prefills = self._schedule_prefills(budget,
   914→                                               curr_loras,
   915→                                               enable_chunking=False)
   916→
   917→        # Don't schedule decodes if prefills are scheduled.
   918→        # NOTE: If `_schedule_prefills` doesn't enable chunking, self.running
   919→        # only contains decode requests, not chunked prefills.
   920→        if len(prefills.seq_groups) == 0:
   921→            running_scheduled = self._schedule_running(budget,
   922→                                                       curr_loras,
   923→                                                       enable_chunking=False)
   924→
   925→            # If any sequence group is preempted, do not swap in any sequence
   926→            # group. because it means there's no slot for new running requests.
   927→            if len(running_scheduled.preempted) + len(
   928→                    running_scheduled.swapped_out) == 0:
   929→                swapped_in = self._schedule_swapped(budget, curr_loras)
   930→
   931→        assert (budget.num_batched_tokens <=
   932→                self.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens)
   933→        assert budget.num_curr_seqs <= self.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs
   934→
   935→        # Update waiting requests.
   936→        self.waiting.extendleft(running_scheduled.preempted)
   937→        # Update new running requests.
   938→        if len(prefills.seq_groups) > 0:
   939→            self.running.extend([s.seq_group for s in prefills.seq_groups])
   940→
   941→        self.running.extend(running_scheduled.decode_seq_groups_list)
   942→
   943→        if len(swapped_in.decode_seq_groups) > 0:
   944→            self.running.extend(
   945→                [s.seq_group for s in swapped_in.decode_seq_groups])
   946→
   947→        # Update swapped requests.
   948→        self.swapped.extend(running_scheduled.swapped_out)
   949→        preempted = (len(running_scheduled.preempted) +
   950→                     len(running_scheduled.swapped_out))
   951→
   952→        # There should be no prefill from running queue because this policy
   953→        # doesn't allow chunked prefills.
   954→        assert len(running_scheduled.prefill_seq_groups) == 0
   955→        assert len(swapped_in.prefill_seq_groups) == 0
   956→
   957→        # Merge lists
   958→        num_prefill_groups = len(prefills.seq_groups)
   959→        if num_prefill_groups > 0:
   960→            scheduled_seq_groups = prefills.seq_groups
   961→            scheduled_seq_groups.extend(running_scheduled.decode_seq_groups)
   962→        else:
   963→            scheduled_seq_groups = running_scheduled.decode_seq_groups
   964→        scheduled_seq_groups.extend(swapped_in.decode_seq_groups)
   965→
   966→        blocks_to_copy = running_scheduled.blocks_to_copy
   967→        blocks_to_copy.extend(swapped_in.blocks_to_copy)
   968→
   969→        ignored_seq_groups = prefills.ignored_seq_groups
   970→        ignored_seq_groups.extend(swapped_in.infeasible_seq_groups)
   971→
   972→        return SchedulerOutputs(
   973→            scheduled_seq_groups=scheduled_seq_groups,
   974→            num_prefill_groups=num_prefill_groups,
   975→            num_batched_tokens=budget.num_batched_tokens,
   976→            blocks_to_swap_in=swapped_in.blocks_to_swap_in,
   977→            blocks_to_swap_out=running_scheduled.blocks_to_swap_out,
   978→            blocks_to_copy=blocks_to_copy,
   979→            ignored_seq_groups=ignored_seq_groups,
   980→            num_lookahead_slots=running_scheduled.num_lookahead_slots,
   981→            running_queue_size=len(self.running),
   982→            preempted=preempted,
   983→        )
   984→
   985→    def _schedule_chunked_prefill(self) -> SchedulerOutputs:
   986→        """Schedule queued requests.
   987→        
   988→        Chunked prefill allows to chunk prefill requests, batch them together
   989→        with decode requests. This policy 1. schedule as many decoding requests
   990→        as possible. 2. schedule chunked prefill requests that are not
   991→        finished. 3. schedule swapped request. 4. schedule new prefill
   992→        requests.
   993→
   994→        The policy can sustain the high GPU utilization because it can put
   995→        prefill and decodes requests to the same batch, while it improves
   996→        inter token latency because decodes requests don't need to be blocked
   997→        by prefill requests.
   998→        """
   999→        budget = SchedulingBudget(
  1000→            token_budget=self.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
  1001→            max_num_seqs=self.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs,
  1002→        )
  1003→        curr_loras: Set[int] = set()
  1004→
  1005→        prefills = SchedulerPrefillOutputs.create_empty()
  1006→        swapped_in = SchedulerSwappedInOutputs.create_empty()
  1007→
  1008→        # Decoding should be always scheduled first by fcfs.
  1009→        running_scheduled = self._schedule_running(budget,
  1010→                                                   curr_loras,
  1011→                                                   enable_chunking=True)
  1012→
  1013→        # Schedule swapped out requests.
  1014→        # If preemption happens, it means we don't have space for swap-in.
  1015→        if len(running_scheduled.preempted) + len(
  1016→                running_scheduled.swapped_out) == 0:
  1017→            swapped_in = self._schedule_swapped(budget, curr_loras)
  1018→
  1019→        # Schedule new prefills.
  1020→        prefills = self._schedule_prefills(budget,
  1021→                                           curr_loras,
  1022→                                           enable_chunking=True)
  1023→
  1024→        assert (budget.num_batched_tokens <=
  1025→                self.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens)
  1026→        assert budget.num_curr_seqs <= self.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs
  1027→
  1028→        # Update waiting requests.
  1029→        self.waiting.extendleft(running_scheduled.preempted)
  1030→
  1031→        # Update new running requests.
  1032→        # By default, vLLM scheduler prioritizes prefills.
  1033→        # Once chunked prefill is enabled,
  1034→        # the policy is changed to prioritize decode requests.
  1035→        self.running.extend(
  1036→            [s.seq_group for s in swapped_in.decode_seq_groups])
  1037→        self.running.extend(
  1038→            [s.seq_group for s in swapped_in.prefill_seq_groups])
  1039→        self.running.extend(
  1040→            [s.seq_group for s in running_scheduled.decode_seq_groups])
  1041→        self.running.extend(
  1042→            [s.seq_group for s in running_scheduled.prefill_seq_groups])
  1043→        self.running.extend([s.seq_group for s in prefills.seq_groups])
  1044→
  1045→        # Update swapped requests.
  1046→        self.swapped.extend(running_scheduled.swapped_out)
  1047→        return SchedulerOutputs(
  1048→            scheduled_seq_groups=(prefills.seq_groups +
  1049→                                  running_scheduled.prefill_seq_groups +
  1050→                                  swapped_in.prefill_seq_groups +
  1051→                                  running_scheduled.decode_seq_groups +
  1052→                                  swapped_in.decode_seq_groups),
  1053→            num_prefill_groups=(len(prefills.seq_groups) +
  1054→                                len(swapped_in.prefill_seq_groups) +
  1055→                                len(running_scheduled.prefill_seq_groups)),
  1056→            num_batched_tokens=budget.num_batched_tokens,
  1057→            blocks_to_swap_in=swapped_in.blocks_to_swap_in,
  1058→            blocks_to_swap_out=running_scheduled.blocks_to_swap_out,
  1059→            blocks_to_copy=running_scheduled.blocks_to_copy +
  1060→            swapped_in.blocks_to_copy,
  1061→            ignored_seq_groups=prefills.ignored_seq_groups +
  1062→            swapped_in.infeasible_seq_groups,
  1063→            num_lookahead_slots=running_scheduled.num_lookahead_slots,
  1064→            running_queue_size=len(self.running),
  1065→            preempted=(len(running_scheduled.preempted) +
  1066→                       len(running_scheduled.swapped_out)),
  1067→        )
  1068→
  1069→    def _schedule(self) -> SchedulerOutputs:
  1070→        """Schedule queued requests."""
  1071→        if self.scheduler_config.chunked_prefill_enabled:
  1072→            return self._schedule_chunked_prefill()
  1073→        else:
  1074→            return self._schedule_default()

  1076→    def _can_append_slots(self, seq_group: SequenceGroup) -> bool:
  1077→        """Determine whether or not we have enough space in the KV cache to
  1078→        continue generation of the sequence group.
  1079→        """
  1080→        # It is True only for testing case to trigger artificial preemption.
  1081→        if (self.enable_artificial_preemption
  1082→                and random.uniform(0, 1) < ARTIFICIAL_PREEMPTION_PROB
  1083→                and self.artificial_preempt_cnt > 0):
  1084→            self.artificial_preempt_cnt -= 1
  1085→            return False
  1086→
  1087→        # Appending slots only occurs in decoding.
  1088→        is_prefill = False
  1089→
  1090→        return self.block_manager.can_append_slots(
  1091→            seq_group=seq_group,
  1092→            num_lookahead_slots=self._get_num_lookahead_slots(is_prefill),
  1093→        )
  1094→
  1095→    def _allow_async_output_proc(self, seq_group: SequenceGroup) -> bool:
  1096→        no_beam_search = seq_group.sampling_params is None or (
  1097→            seq_group.sampling_params.best_of == 1
  1098→            and not seq_group.sampling_params.use_beam_search)
  1099→        return no_beam_search

  1101→    def schedule(
  1102→            self

  1242→                if seq_group.metrics.scheduler_time is not None:

  1244→                else:

  1358→                "performance. Increase gpu_memory_utilization or "
  1359→                "tensor_parallel_size to provide more KV cache memory. "

  1361→                preemption_mode, self.num_cumulative_preemption + 1)

  1454→        phase, so chunking doesn't happen.

  1470→                # the number of new tokens that is dividable by the block size
  1471→                # to avoid partial block matching.

  1476→                                     "prefix caching, max_num_batched_tokens "

  1478→                                     "block size, but got chunk_size "
  1479→                                     f"({budget.token_budget}) % block_size "
  1480→                                     f"({block_size}) = {reminder}")
  1481→                if remaining_token_budget < num_new_tokens:

import enum
import os
import random
import time
from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import (Callable, Deque, Dict, Iterable, List, Optional, Set,
                    Tuple, Union)

from vllm.config import CacheConfig, LoRAConfig, SchedulerConfig
from vllm.core.interfaces import AllocStatus, BlockSpaceManager
from vllm.logger import init_logger
from vllm.lora.request import LoRARequest
from vllm.prompt_adapter.request import PromptAdapterRequest
from vllm.sequence import (Sequence, SequenceData, SequenceGroup,
                           SequenceGroupMetadata, SequenceGroupMetadataDelta,
                           SequenceStatus)
from vllm.utils import Device, PyObjectCache

logger = init_logger(__name__)

# Test-only. If configured, decode is preempted with
# ARTIFICIAL_PREEMPTION_PROB% probability.
ENABLE_ARTIFICIAL_PREEMPT = bool(
    os.getenv("VLLM_TEST_ENABLE_ARTIFICIAL_PREEMPT", False))  # noqa
ARTIFICIAL_PREEMPTION_PROB = 0.5
ARTIFICIAL_PREEMPTION_MAX_CNT = 500


class PreemptionMode(enum.Enum):
    """Preemption modes.

    1. Swapping: Swap out the blocks of the preempted sequences to CPU memory
    and swap them back in when the sequences are resumed.
    2. Recomputation: Discard the blocks of the preempted sequences and
    recompute them when the sequences are resumed, treating the sequences as
    new prompts.
    """
    SWAP = enum.auto()
    RECOMPUTE = enum.auto()


@dataclass
class SchedulingBudget:
    """The available slots for scheduling.

    TODO(sang): Right now, the budget is request_id-aware meaning it can ignore
    budget update from the same request_id. It is because in normal scheduling
    path, we update RUNNING num_seqs ahead of time, meaning it could be
    updated more than once when scheduling RUNNING requests. Since this won't
    happen if we only have chunked prefill scheduling, we can remove this
    feature from the API when chunked prefill is enabled by default.
    """
    token_budget: int
    max_num_seqs: int
    _request_ids_num_batched_tokens: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    _request_ids_num_curr_seqs: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    _num_batched_tokens: int = 0
    _num_curr_seqs: int = 0

    def can_schedule(self, *, num_new_tokens: int, num_new_seqs: int):
        assert num_new_tokens != 0
        assert num_new_seqs != 0
        return (self.num_batched_tokens + num_new_tokens <= self.token_budget
                and self.num_curr_seqs + num_new_seqs <= self.max_num_seqs)

    def remaining_token_budget(self):
        return self.token_budget - self.num_batched_tokens

    def add_num_batched_tokens(self, req_id: str, num_batched_tokens: int):
        if req_id in self._request_ids_num_batched_tokens:
            return

        self._request_ids_num_batched_tokens.add(req_id)
        self._num_batched_tokens += num_batched_tokens

    def subtract_num_batched_tokens(self, req_id: str,
                                    num_batched_tokens: int):
        if req_id in self._request_ids_num_batched_tokens:
            self._request_ids_num_batched_tokens.remove(req_id)
            self._num_batched_tokens -= num_batched_tokens

    def add_num_seqs(self, req_id: str, num_curr_seqs: int):
        if req_id in self._request_ids_num_curr_seqs:
            return

        self._request_ids_num_curr_seqs.add(req_id)
        self._num_curr_seqs += num_curr_seqs

    def subtract_num_seqs(self, req_id: str, num_curr_seqs: int):
        if req_id in self._request_ids_num_curr_seqs:
            self._request_ids_num_curr_seqs.remove(req_id)
            self._num_curr_seqs -= num_curr_seqs

    @property
    def num_batched_tokens(self):
        return self._num_batched_tokens

    @property
    def num_curr_seqs(self):
        return self._num_curr_seqs


@dataclass
class ScheduledSequenceGroup:
    # A sequence group that's scheduled.
    seq_group: SequenceGroup
    # The total chunk size (number of tokens) to process for next iteration.
    # 1 for decoding. Same as prompt tokens for prefill, but if prefill is
    # chunked, it can be smaller than that.
    token_chunk_size: int


@dataclass
class SchedulerOutputs:
    """The scheduling decision made from a scheduler."""
    # Scheduled sequence groups.
    scheduled_seq_groups: Iterable[ScheduledSequenceGroup]
    # Number of prefill groups scheduled.
    num_prefill_groups: int
    # Total number of batched tokens.
    num_batched_tokens: int
    # Blocks to swap in. List of CPU -> GPU block number.
    blocks_to_swap_in: List[Tuple[int, int]]
    # Blocks to swap out. List of GPU -> CPU block number.
    blocks_to_swap_out: List[Tuple[int, int]]
    # Blocks to copy. Source to dest block.
    blocks_to_copy: List[Tuple[int, int]]
    # Sequence groups that are going to be ignored.
    ignored_seq_groups: List[SequenceGroup]
    # The number of slots for lookahead decoding.
    num_lookahead_slots: int
    # The number of requests in the running queue
    running_queue_size: int
    preempted: int

    def __post_init__(self):
        # Swap in and swap out should never happen at the same time.
        assert not (self.blocks_to_swap_in and self.blocks_to_swap_out)

        self.num_loras: int = len(self.lora_requests)
        if self.num_loras > 0:
            self._sort_by_lora_ids()

        self.num_prompt_adapters: int = len(self.prompt_adapter_requests)

    def is_empty(self) -> bool:
        # NOTE: We do not consider the ignored sequence groups.
        return (not self.scheduled_seq_groups and not self.blocks_to_swap_in
                and not self.blocks_to_swap_out and not self.blocks_to_copy)

    def _sort_by_lora_ids(self):
        self.scheduled_seq_groups = sorted(
            self.scheduled_seq_groups,
            key=lambda g: (g.seq_group.lora_int_id, g.seq_group.request_id))

    @property
    def lora_requests(self) -> Set[LoRARequest]:
        return {
            g.seq_group.lora_request
            for g in self.scheduled_seq_groups
            if g.seq_group.lora_request is not None
        }

    @property
    def prompt_adapter_requests(self) -> Set[PromptAdapterRequest]:
        return {
            g.seq_group.prompt_adapter_request
            for g in self.scheduled_seq_groups
            if g.seq_group.prompt_adapter_request is not None
        }


@dataclass
class SchedulerRunningOutputs:
    """The requests that are scheduled from a running queue.

    Could contain prefill (prefill that's chunked) or decodes. If there's not
    enough memory, it can be preempted (for recompute) or swapped out.
    """
    # Selected sequences that are running and in a decoding phase.
    decode_seq_groups: List[ScheduledSequenceGroup]
    # Selected sequences that are running and in a prefill phase.
    # I.e., it means the prefill has been chunked.
    prefill_seq_groups: List[ScheduledSequenceGroup]
    # The preempted sequences.
    preempted: List[SequenceGroup]
    # Sequences that are swapped out.
    swapped_out: List[SequenceGroup]
    # The blocks to swap out.
    blocks_to_swap_out: List[Tuple[int, int]]
    # The blocks to copy.
    blocks_to_copy: List[Tuple[int, int]]
    # The number of slots for lookahead decoding.
    num_lookahead_slots: int

    # Optimization for fast-access to seq_group lists
    decode_seq_groups_list: List[SequenceGroup]
    prefill_seq_groups_list: List[SequenceGroup]

    @classmethod
    def create_empty(cls) -> "SchedulerRunningOutputs":
        return SchedulerRunningOutputs(
            decode_seq_groups=[],
            prefill_seq_groups=[],
            preempted=[],
            swapped_out=[],
            blocks_to_swap_out=[],
            blocks_to_copy=[],
            num_lookahead_slots=0,
            decode_seq_groups_list=[],
            prefill_seq_groups_list=[],
        )


@dataclass
class SchedulerSwappedInOutputs:
    """The requests that are scheduled from a swap queue.

    Could contain prefill (prefill that's chunked) or decodes.
    """
    # Selected sequences that are going to be swapped in and is in a
    # decoding phase.
    decode_seq_groups: List[ScheduledSequenceGroup]
    # Selected sequences that are going to be swapped in and in a prefill
    # phase. I.e., it means the prefill has been chunked.
    prefill_seq_groups: List[ScheduledSequenceGroup]

    blocks_to_swap_in: List[Tuple[int, int]]
    # The blocks to copy.
    blocks_to_copy: List[Tuple[int, int]]
    # The number of slots for lookahead decoding.
    num_lookahead_slots: int
    # Infeasible sequence groups.
    infeasible_seq_groups: List[SequenceGroup]

    @classmethod
    def create_empty(cls) -> "SchedulerSwappedInOutputs":
        return SchedulerSwappedInOutputs(
            decode_seq_groups=[],
            prefill_seq_groups=[],
            blocks_to_swap_in=[],
            blocks_to_copy=[],
            num_lookahead_slots=0,

        )


@dataclass
class SchedulerPrefillOutputs:

    Could contain a fresh prefill requests or preempted requests that need

    seq_groups: List[ScheduledSequenceGroup]
    # Ignored sequence groups.

    def create_empty(cls) -> "SchedulerPrefillOutputs":
